english.title: Operator or pilot of UK registered public transport aircraft commence flight in visibility below relevant minimum
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of a public transport aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which commenced a flight at a time when

(C)_[the cloud ceiling or the runway visual range at **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..) the aerodrome of departure was less than the relevant minimum specified for take-off, namely **(..SPECIFY MINIMUM RANGE..)]_
(D)_[according to the information available to the pilot in command of the aircraft it would not be able without contravening article 131(11) or (12) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 , to land at **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..) the aerodrome of intended destination at the estimated time of arrival there and at any destination alternate aerodrome at any time at which according to a reasonable estimate the aircraft would have arrived there]_
(E)_[according to the information available to you it would not be able without contravening article 131(11) or (12) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 , to land at **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..) the aerodrome of intended destination at the estimated time of arrival there and at any destination alternate aerodrome at any time at which according to a reasonable estimate the aircraft would have arrived there]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 131(10) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
were the operator pilot in command of a public transport aircraft registered in the United Kingdom
which commenced a flight at a time when
the cloud ceiling or the runway visual range at the aerodrome of departure was less than the relevant minimum specified for take-off OR
according to the information available to the operator / pilot in command of the aircraft it would not be able without contravening article 131(11) or (12) of the Order to land at the aerodrome of intended destination at the estimated time of arrival there
and at any destination alternate aerodrome at any time at which according to a reasonable estimate the aircraft would have arrived there
